subject: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Team —

Following our capacity review, I’m requesting approval to open two headcount slots for the runtime team in Q4 and to provision offer-band guidance for recruiting. Summary below: 

- Roles requested (2 slots):
  * Senior Runtime Engineer (x1) — production-critical (latency, batching, KV-cache work)
  * Platform SRE (x1) — infra reliability / autoscaling / capacity planning
- Proposed start window: target hire dates between Oct 18–Nov 15, 2026
- Headcount ask: 2 FTEs net-new (non-replacement)
- Funding owner: Platform product; initial forecasted FY26/27 OTE + fully-burdened cost: ~ $360k/year (both roles combined) including benefits and G&A allocation

Comp bands (recommended):
- Senior Runtime Engineer: Band SRE-4 / Eng-5: base $200k–$230k; target offer midpoint $215k; sign-on up to $25k for strong ICs.
- Platform SRE: Band SRE-3: base $170k–$195k; target offer midpoint $182k; sign-on up to $15k.

Attachments: HC_Request_Q4_2026.pdf (one-pager headcount case) and Comp_Band_Proposal_Q4.xlsx (breakdown by hire, total comp, and run-rate). I also copied Marcus for HR/comp ops validation and Karthik for budget sign-off.

Ask: please reply with approve / need changes / rejected by COB Monday (Aug 23). If approved, I’ll engage Talent Partners (cc’d) with the approved band and move to active sourcing.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear write-up. A couple of quick clarifications before I can greenlight: 

1) Do we have a cost-center and budget head allocation for the FY27 run-rate? I want to ensure this doesn’t push other platform initiatives off the slate.
2) Are both hires headcount-adds (not backfills)? Confirmed — you said non-replacement but want this explicit for Finance.
3) Can you add expected velocity / impact metric (e.g., percent reduction in tail latency or incidents mitigated) — helps justify the sign-on budget.

If we have Finance alignment, I’m comfortable with the bands you proposed.

- Karthik
VP, Platform & Product Operations
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Hannah / Karthik —

Quick technical justification to include for the packet: 
- Incident trend: runtime tail latency incidents impacting p95/p99 have increased 18% QoQ due to higher seq lengths in a few high-traffic customers; projected to cost ~$150k in customer support and credits if unaddressed.
- Backlog: KV cache improvements, continuous-batching optimizations, and a streaming-path rewrite are blocked or significantly delayed without additional engineering capacity.
- Expected impact: with two additional FTEs (one focused on core runtime optimizations, one on platform reliability), we estimate: 40–50% reduction in p99 incident recurrence and 30% faster median rebuild time for hot shards.

If you want, I’ll add a 1-page appendix to the HC packet with the incident log and projected cost avoidance.

—Dev
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Recruiter <susan@talentpartners.io>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Team —

Thanks — HR/CompOps notes: 
- Bands look reasonable vs market comps; I’ll validate comp ranges against last quarter’s market data and update Comp_Band_Proposal_Q4.xlsx with percentile guidance.
- For offers we should:
  * Hold hiring manager target offers to midpoint for the first two rounds to preserve budget flexibility.
  * Reserve discretionary sign-on authority centrally; any sign-on > $20k will need my explicit sign-off.
- Process note: once you have approvals, Talent Partners (cc’d) will start pipelining candidates. Please share JD and must-have skill list.

Susan — can you confirm expected lead time to present 3 qualified candidates after go-ahead?

—Marcus
Director, Talent & Comp Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Susan Recruiter <susan@talentpartners.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Marcus / Hannah / Karthik —

We can present 3–5 vetted candidates for the Senior Runtime Engineer role within 15 business days of receiving the JD and final comp band. For the Platform SRE slot, expect 12–18 business days. I’ve attached a short pipeline snapshot (Candidate_Pipeline_TalentPartners.pdf) — two passive candidates are already interested and would require an above-midpoint approach.

Also attaching standard recruiter fee schedule — let me know if we should pursue a high-priority outreach.

Best,
Susan
Talent Partners
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Recruiter <susan@talentpartners.io>, Finance Approvals <finance-approvals@vendorco.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime resourcing: proposed hires and offer bands (Q4 intake)

Thanks all —

Updated packet attached (Comp_Band_Proposal_Q4.xlsx includes Marcus’s percentile guidance and an appendix from Dev with incident-cost projections). I’ve annotated the HC_Request_Q4_2026.pdf with explicit funding lines (cost center: PLAT-RUN-2026).

Next steps I’m requesting: 
1) Karthik — conditional approval to open two reqs (pending Finance confirmation of cost-center funding).
2) Marcus — sign-off on band midpoints and sign-on caps as you noted.
3) Finance Approvals (cc’d external mailbox) — please confirm chargeability to PLAT-RUN-2026 and that hiring can proceed within the current committed spend.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD Tuesday (Aug 25), I’ll instruct Talent Partners to start outreach and post the internal reqs.

Appended files for reviewers: HC_Request_Q4_2026.pdf; Comp_Band_Proposal_Q4.xlsx; Candidate_Pipeline_TalentPartners.pdf

—Hannah
Director, Runtime Platform
